questions.question: What can Hairpin do to nails?
questions.subject: Hairpin

answer.item: Nails manipulated with the Straw Doll Technique can be used to greatly enhance their output of cursed energy, which expands with explosive force and highly magnifies the nails' destructive capabilities.
